scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Aam Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Must have agricultural land between 0.25 and 10 acres (0.1 to 4 ha)
Must be registered on the DBT portal
Only ryot farmers are eligible to apply
benefits_summary: Financial support up to ₹18,000 per hectare in the first year and ₹6,000 per hectare in the second and third years, plus supply of high-quality plants.
